_meta.description: Per-risk-tier nudge cadence + tone modifiers. Applied on top of the per-zone calendar in season_calendar_by_zone.json. The NudgeSchedulerAgent uses cadence_days to decide whether a farmer is due for a nudge today.

High.tone_guidance: This farmer is at high risk of not selling back. Be warm and personal but get to the point quickly. Use their name. Be concrete: 'Visit your field today and check X.' Always offer the option to escalate to a field agent ('reply 2 if you need help and we will call you'). Avoid alarmist language; framing should be 'we are here to help you finish strong'.

Medium.tone_guidance: This farmer is moderately at risk. A weekly check-in reminder is appropriate. Encourage good practices, celebrate progress, gently reinforce repayment commitment.

Low.tone_guidance: This farmer is on track. Light bi-weekly check-ins to reinforce good behavior and gather data. Brief, friendly, mostly informational.
